launch: Native Python and local Ollama; local toy ERP on port 8100

reproducibility: Use uv sync --frozen. For native execution change host.docker.internal to localhost in .env and use make commands with RUN="env PYTHONPATH=src uv run". Start the original ERP service and Ollama as in docs/setup.md. Submitted response cache is used by LLMClient.
